description.value: Fire Hall Kitchen & Tap is a craft beer tap house and gastropub housed in the heritage Fire Hall No.1 building in downtown Cranbrook, a couple of turns off the Crowsnest Highway. It pours exclusively BC craft beers across 20 taps and offers a full food menu in a Kootenay-culture setting. A natural post-ride stop for cyclists exploring the southern Rockies, trails, and surrounding backcountry.

address.value: 37 11th Ave S, Cranbrook, British Columbia V1C 2N9, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at firehallcbk.ca is fully functional and confirms an active gastropub in downtown Cranbrook. Address, both phone numbers, and email are listed consistently across all subpages. Takeout is confirmed by prominent 'TAKEOUT MENU' and 'ORDER ONLINE' links on the homepage. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Two different phone numbers appear on the website: (250) 417-7250 and (778) 520-0911. The former appears as the primary footer listing; the latter appears as a secondary entry. Unclear which is current or whether one is a legacy number.
OSM record has no address or phone — both sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible gastropub in downtown Cranbrook with a confirmed website, upcoming events, and online ordering — a clear include for the directory.
